title: mime-tree: implement parse() entry point
description: Core function — converts raw RFC 5322 bytes into ParsedMessage via mail-parser. mail-parser is a private impl detail; no mail-parser types may appear in the public API. Key challenge: recover byte offsets from mail-parser's sub-slices via pointer arithmetic (sub.as_ptr() as usize - raw.as_ptr() as usize). Best-effort: malformed parts append to ParsedMessage.warnings rather than returning Err. Only truly unparseable input (empty, no headers) returns Err(ParseError).
acceptance_criteria: parse() returns ParsedMessage for valid and malformed inputs; byte ranges index correctly into the original raw slice; no mail-parser types in public API
